# Giovanni Zanotti

> BSc Computer Science Student at the University of Pisa (UniPi) specializing in Embedded Systems, Edge Computing, IoT, and Formal Methods.

Personal portfolio and technical index for Giovanni Zanotti (GiZano), software developer and computer science student at the University of Pisa. His work focuses on safety-critical edge architectures, real-time operating systems (RTOS), low-power IoT sensing networks, and local-first application development.

## Core Projects

- [QuakeGuard](https://giovanni-zanotti.is-a.dev/projects/quakeguard): Real-time seismic detection network at the edge using MEMS accelerometers, RTOS (FreeRTOS / Zephyr), and distributed MQTT telemetry. Winner of the GF Marilli technical competition.
- [ClimbStack](https://giovanni-zanotti.is-a.dev/projects/climbstack): Local-first, offline-first mobile application gamifying long-term goals into visual climbs, featuring weekly time-blocking and zero cloud latency. Built with React Native and SQLite. Available on Google Play.
- [bE-More](https://giovanni-zanotti.is-a.dev/projects/be-more): Corporate energy optimization platform bridging edge microcontroller telemetry (Arduino UNO R4 WiFi with custom shield) and local AI decision engines. First-place winner at Project Day.
- [Burrows-Wheeler Transform Demo](https://giovanni-zanotti.is-a.dev/projects/burrows-wheeler): Interactive web-based visualization of the Burrows-Wheeler block-sorting transform, run-length encoding (RLE), and Huffman coding.
- [Curious Traveler](https://giovanni-zanotti.is-a.dev/projects/curious-traveler): Real-time flight tracking and discovery dashboard querying open aeronautical APIs.
- [Bench](https://giovanni-zanotti.is-a.dev/projects/bench): Lightweight hardware profiling and benchmarking tool designed to evaluate local compute throughput.

## Technical Writing & Case Studies

- [Winning a Tech Contest with bE-More](https://gizano.hashnode.dev/winning-a-tech-contest-with-be-more-integrating-iot-and-local-ai-for-a-greener-office): Architectural overview of edge telemetry, physical prototyping with custom Arduino shields, and local AI recommendations.
- [Fighting Decision Fatigue: How ClimbStack was Born](https://gizano.hashnode.dev/fighting-decision-fatigue-how-climbstack-was-born): Design principles, cognitive friction reduction, and local-first mobile engineering with React Native and SQLite.

## Technical Expertise

- **Embedded Systems & IoT**: Zephyr RTOS, FreeRTOS, Arduino, ESP32, MEMS sensors, MQTT, Edge Computing, hardware prototyping, custom shield design.
- **Languages**: C, C++, Python, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, SQL, Bash.
- **Mobile & Web**: React Native, Vanilla HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript, SQLite, Bootstrap, REST APIs.
- **Academic & Theory**: Formal Methods, Concurrency Semantics, Algorithms & Data Structures.
